content:
On Saturday, news broke that Miley Cyrus had married her longtime partner, musician Maxx Morando, in a private ceremony in Palm Springs, California.

Gilbert Flores / Getty Images

The two first met after a mutual friend set them up on a blind date back in 2021, and they went public with their romance in November of that same year.

Kevin Winter / Getty Images

While we don’t have much insight into the wedding at the moment, both of Cyrus’ parents were pictured heading to the ceremony. We also got some drone paparazzi shots of the incredibly intimate nuptials, which ended up going viral for a very specific reason.

You see, in one of the photos, we can see all of the wedding guests as they watch Cyrus and Morando say their vows. Every single person on both sides of the aisle looks incredibly chic, dressed in just black and white… Apart from one woman, who stands out like a sore thumb in bright yellow. You can view the photo for yourself here.

Amy Sussman / Getty Images

Needless to say, this one person so brazenly breaking an obvious black-tie dress code immediately caused a stir on social media. One quote-tweet with more than 72,000 likes simply reads: “showing up to a wedding out of the requested dress code is soooo tacky. what a loser.”

“Yellow dress would’ve had to be escorted out tbh,” somebody else wrote. Another added: “The woman in the yellow is giving me the ick.” One more asked: “now why did that girl in the yellow ruin Miley’s wedding theme…”

And now, the woman’s sister has come to her defense — revealing that the whole mix-up was basically her husband’s fault.

Steve Granitz / Getty Images

It’s worth noting that Shawn follows Grecia’s Instagram account, verifying that she is connected to the couple.

As it happens, the woman in yellow is actually Belgica Vargas, who is married to music producer Shawn Everett; Everett is a close friend of Cyrus’. On Sunday night, her sister, Grecia, commented on a viral Instagram video calling out the dress code violation, writing: “She didn’t know guys , her husband is really good friends with Miley and if you knew my bro inlaw then you would totally understand . My sister should have known better to double check on the invite 😂 . Anyway Miley is a sweetheart so she didn’t care as much as the internet does. Our family is having a few laughs .”

When asked if the invite had been last-minute, Grecia added: “No , they’ve known for along time . My sister said she saw the invite 2 months ago and is gonna go home soon to see the invite and to see where they missed the memo. Her husband is a colorful guy so we’re surprised he wore black 😂.”

Anyways, this development has made the public response to the yellow outfit switch from outrage to pure sympathy, with many people sharing how mortified they’d be in Vargas’ situation. One person joked: “of course this entire situation was a man’s fault.” Somebody else said in response to Grecia’s second comment: “so shawn ACCIDENTALLY followed the dress code 😂😂 I feel bad for your sister tho, we should all know that Miley wouldn't mind.” Another wrote: “tell her she is owed at least one very [nice] night out together and a day of all of her favorite things.”

Dia Dipasupil / Getty Images

All’s well that ends well, right? Let me know your thoughts in the comments below!
